title: Every fixed polynomial Wick-Krylov residual retains a uniformly nonzero top Wiener chaos

polynomial_top_chaos.notation: Write X_N=I_4(f_N)/sigma_N with E(X_N^2)=1. For j>=0 let q_(j,N) be the monic degree-j polynomial orthogonal to 1,X_N,...,X_N^(j-1), and put h_(j,N)=E(q_(j,N)(X_N)^2)
polynomial_top_chaos.top_chaos_identity: Lower powers have Wiener degree at most 4(j-1), so P_(4j) q_(j,N)(X_N)=P_(4j) X_N^j=I_(4j)(sym(f_N tensor ... tensor f_N))/sigma_N^j
polynomial_top_chaos.symmetrization_lower_bound: In the symmetrization norm the block-preserving permutations contribute (4!)^j||f_N||^(2j); every coefficient product is nonnegative in the Fourier kernel representation, hence ||P_(4j)X_N^j||_2^2>=1
polynomial_top_chaos.residual_lower_bound: Therefore h_(j,N)>=1 for every cutoff and every j; no finite monic Krylov residual collapses
polynomial_top_chaos.hypercontractive_upper_bound: Because q_(j,N) minimizes the L2 norm among monic degree-j polynomials, h_(j,N)<=E|X_N|^(2j)<=H_j:=(2j-1)^(4j) for j>=1, with H_0=1
polynomial_top_chaos.finite_chaos_degree: Every normalized polynomial direction phi_(j,N)=q_(j,N)(X_N)/sqrt(h_(j,N)) lies in Wiener chaoses of degree at most 4j
polynomial_top_chaos.ceiling: The bounds are uniform only after fixing j. They do not show that the resulting dimension-by-dimension gaps have a non-summable lower bound or that polynomial degree may grow with N at controlled kinetic cost
